$comment: SPEC 15 §8.2 step 2. Pinned versions and SHA-256 digests for every binary shipped in resources/bin. scripts/release/fetch-binaries.mjs verifies each download against this file and fails the release on a mismatch. Digests are filled in by running `node scripts/release/fetch-binaries.mjs --update-hashes` on a trusted machine, then reviewed in a pull request: an unreviewed hash change is exactly how a supply-chain attack would arrive.

ffmpeg.note: Separate executables, spawned as child processes; never linked into the app.

ytDlp.note: The app also updates this at runtime through its own checksum-verified updater (spec 15 §9).

whisper.note: Built by CI from the pinned tag into baseline and AVX2 variants (spec 15 §6.2).
